note: Rustic Alberta Parks campground in the forest by the Livingstone River, 60 km north of Crowsnest on the Forestry Trunk Road (Hwy 940), with a cook shelter and nearby trails. No firewood is available; bring or buy it locally. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the Alberta Parks page (updated Jun 5, 2026): 22 unserviced first-come sites C$26, season May 15 - Oct 1 (derived -> manual, same dates), pit toilets, non-potable pump, cook shelter. Facilities written (vault true, potable false). Riverview not confirmable: recommend not waterfront. Pin ~290 m off: move to 50.1018,-114.4420.
flags: WATERFRONT (stored riverview, checked hard): recommend NOT WATERFRONT (lower value; unsure). Current Esri imagery (2023-10-17) is cloud over the campground; the clear Wayback release of 2017-06-14 (0.38 m/px) shows both loops' spurs under continuous conifer canopy ~40-100 m NE of the Livingstone River, with forest between. The page says nothing about the river. The old note's 'riverside lower loop with sites against the bank' has no source on the page. Lead: a white object (camper?) sits at the river bend at ~50.1016,-114.4443, which may be a riverbank site or the falls day-use; without a site number it cannot carry riverview or riverfront.

PIN MOVE: stored 50.10014,-114.43930 sits at the access road's junction with Hwy 940, ~290 m SE of the sites. Recommend 50.1018,-114.4420 (between the two loops; the page's directions point 50.101798,-114.441246 is in the upper loop and also works).
PHONE: stored 403-627-1165 matches the page's 'Information: 403-627-1165'. No Facility Operator line.
